title: Inventories
intro: المخزون يُقاس بـ **الأقل** بين التكلفة وصافي القيمة القابلة للتحقق (NRV).
التكلفة = شراء + تحويل + أي تكلفة لوصول المخزون لمكانه وحالته الحالية. الهالك غير العادي والتخزين والمصروفات الإدارية والبيعية مصروف.
طرق التكلفة المسموحة: FIFO والمتوسط المرجح والتمييز المحدد. LIFO ممنوعة.

tf.s: Selling costs are included in the cost of inventories.
tf.why: Selling costs are expensed. They are deducted when calculating NRV, not added to cost.

tf.s: The retail method may be used if the result approximates cost.
tf.why: IAS 2 allows standard cost and retail methods for convenience when results approximate cost.

tf.s: Trade discounts and rebates are deducted in determining the cost of purchase.
tf.why: Cost of purchase is net of trade discounts, rebates and similar items.

tf.s: Write-downs to NRV are normally made item by item.
tf.why: Item by item is the normal rule. Grouping is allowed only for similar or related items, not whole classes.

tf.s: When inventories are sold, their carrying amount is expensed in the period the related revenue is recognised.
tf.why: This matches cost of sales with revenue.

tf.s: General administrative overheads are included in the cost of inventories.
tf.why: Admin overheads that do not bring inventories to their present location and condition are expensed.

je.s: Inventory with a cost of 8,000 has an NRV of 6,500 at year-end. Record the write-down.
je.why: Write down to NRV: 8,000 - 6,500 = 1,500 expense in profit or loss.
